ApiVersions.description: The API versions of this instance.

cliRange.description: The CLI versions this server works with, as a caret range.

state.title: Null unless the state is done or refused.

reason.title: Trimmed, and null when blank, so a blank reason keeps the one the person gave.

account.title: The account the bridge chose for the request, or null when the body names none that could be an account.

install.title: No constraint: a method this server does not know must not refuse the whole heartbeat.

lastRunAt.title: RFC 3339. Null for a hook that has not run since the bridge started.

lastRunAtADate.title: The shape check passes February 31, which the date parser would roll into March.

cliVersion.title: Trimmed, because the length constraint measured the trimmed value.

hooks.title:
The hook rows as the bridge row stores them, with every time in one
format. Null when the bridge sent no report.

workerPools.title:
The worker pool rows as the bridge row stores them. Null when the bridge
sent no report.

capabilities.title: The capability names once each. Null when the bridge sent no report.

workClaims.title:
The pairs of a request id and its claim token, once each. Null when the
bridge sent no list.

name.title: Null when the bridge sent no name. Trimmed, because the constraints read the trimmed value.

accounts.title:
The account rows as the bridge row stores them. A reason is kept for a
failing account alone. Null when the bridge sent no report.

commandEntries.title:
The command entry rows as the bridge row stores them. A blank
description is stored as none. Null when the bridge sent no report.

worktrees.title:
The worktree rows as the bridge row stores them, with the project id in
canonical form. Null when the bridge sent no report.

repositories.title:
The repository rows as the bridge row stores them, with the project id in
canonical form. Null when the bridge sent no report.

workKinds.title: The work kinds once each. Empty when the bridge sent no report.

gitIdentities.title:
The git identity rows as the bridge row stores them, with the project id
in canonical form. Null when the bridge sent no report.

cardNumber.title: Required for a card and absent for any other subject.

workKind.title: The kind of the work request, or the name of the session when it runs no work request.

at.title: The columns carry no time zone, so the moment converts to UTC here.

harness.title: The four harness fields are null from a bridge that predates harnesses. A null keeps the stored value.

costUsd.title: Null when the bridge estimated a model it knows no price for.

durationMs.title: Null when the stream holds no result of the call.

kind.title: Null from an older bridge, which sends no kind.

at.title: The columns carry no time zone, so every moment converts to UTC here.

cardNumber.title: The label of a card subject. Any other subject has none.

hasResult.title: A command prints no result line, so the flag a bridge sends for it says nothing.

continues.title: The id the bridge gave the run that this run resumes.

usage.title: Checked on every state, and stored from an outcome or a stop alone.

peakContextTokens.title: The largest main-session context of the run, stored from an outcome or a stop alone.

workerPool.title: Null from a bridge that predates worker pools.

experiment.title: The four experiment fields are null from a bridge that predates experiments.

kind.title: Null from a bridge that predates command rules, which runs workers alone.

harness.title: The four harness fields are null from a bridge that predates harnesses. A null keeps the stored value.

harnessVersion.title: The three version fields are null from a bridge that predates them. A null keeps the stored value.

harnessEvents.title: Kind to count, from an outcome or a stop. A null keeps the stored map, and an empty object replaces it.

costSource.title: "openrouter" when the run went through OpenRouter, which then bills its cost. A source from a newer bridge reads as none.

result.title: A command prints no result line, so the flag a bridge sends for it says nothing.

weights.title:
The weight of each variant, in the order of the variants. Null when the
choice is invalid, or the weights are not one int from 1 to MAX_WEIGHT for
each variant. A bad list never refuses the pin, so an older bridge that
sends none still runs. A list, because PHP turns a key such as "0" into an int.

metrics.title:
The metric keys the experiment declares, in their order. Null when they
are not a list of 1 to MAX_METRICS unique keys of the right shape. A key
the registry does not know stays, so the page can name it.

headline.title:
The goal, the guards and the controls of the experiment page. Null when
the headline is not an object, or one of its parts is malformed, or it
holds no part. Keys it does not know drop out. An empty guards list
stays, and means no guards. A goal with no better way stays, so the page
can say so. A control names a declared variant, a comparison with a
number, and a share above 0 up to 1.

covers.title:
The work kinds the experiment covers, sorted. Null when they are not a
list of 1 to MAX_COVERS unique kinds of the right shape. A bad list never
refuses the pin, so an older bridge that sends none still runs.

baseline.title:
The variant the others are compared against. Null when it is not one of
the variants of the request, and the controller then refuses the pin.

state.title: Null unless the state is done, refused or open.

validCause.title: Whether the cause is one that a bridge gives.

repository.title: The `owner/name` of the repository, as the worker's git remote names it.

bearerAuth.description: An API key or an OAuth access token, in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
